product_relevance.what_product_question_it_informs: Presence of a TLS-terminating service, as a very indirect infrastructure signal.
product_relevance.weakest_truthful_interpretation: A count of addresses that presented a certificate. Certificate presence is not purchase, not adoption, and not use of any product.
product_relevance.why_weak: The interpretive distance between observing a certificate and any product decision is large, and every shortening of it requires an inference §7 forbids. §8 lets a weak candidate survive only if nothing stronger is viable, and it may never win a tie against a structurally comparable stronger construct.

proposition.canonical_subject: TLS certificate presentation on a fixed port
proposition.predicate: a TLS handshake attempt on a fixed port received a certificate
proposition.exclusion_rule: certificates known only from Certificate Transparency logs are not observations of an address and are excluded
proposition.configuration_assumptions: the port inside both scanned sets

what_a_positive_observation_establishes: That an address presented a certificate on a port at a moment.
explicit_non_claims: not a purchase, a subscription or a customer relationship
not adoption of a certificate authority's product
not the number of sites, since one address may present many certificates by SNI
CT-log presence is not an active measurement and is not a substitute for one

Censys.note: Its certificate collection is described as downloaded from publicly known CT servers OR found during Censys Internet scans. A collection mixing a log transcription with an active observation cannot witness an active-measurement proposition without a way to separate them, and reading a published log is not measuring.

Netlas.note: Certificates are collected and are documented as sometimes the only indicator of a service; the exact observation semantics for this predicate were not resolved.

Rapid7 Project Sonar.note: Two dated certificate studies exist, described as X.509 certificate metadata observed when communicating with endpoints.

failed_hard_conditions: at least TWO apparatus routes are PLAUSIBLE
